thread:
ana: Follow-up from today's postmortem: we need clear owners for statuspage text, customer summary, RCA sharing policy, and a recurrence review. Keep replies short.

mike: I'll draft the statuspage blurb. Aim: non-technical, single sentence + ETA for RCA. Posting draft by tomorrow morning.

leena: I'll take the RCA sharing policy. Proposal: public summary within 48h, full sanitized RCA within 7 days, logs only with explicit account consent. Will add redaction checklist.

jon: I'll own the recurrence review and run a 60/90-day trend check. Will recommend hotfix vs deeper infra change after analysis.

ana: small correction: mention autoscale mitigation in the status copy.

ops-bot: Created tickets: PM-5012 (statuspage copy) -> mike, due 2025-12-01; PM-5013 (RCA sharing policy) -> leena, due 2025-11-29; PM-5014 (recurrence analysis) -> jon, due 2025-12-05.

mike: Draft statuspage line in tracker: "We experienced intermittent write latency impacting a few customers. We applied mitigations to reduce impact and are investigating root cause. A full incident report will be posted within 7 days." Thoughts?

leena: Looks good. Suggest changing "a few customers" to "a small number of customers" for tone. Adding redaction rules to tracker now (remove customer IDs, IPs, internal hostnames; keep aggregated metrics).

jon: Noted. I'll pull alerts and telemetry and push a short slide deck with findings. If I see repeated pattern, recommend a permanent routing change and a postmortem retro action.

ana: If owners miss deadlines, ops should publish the interim summary + statuspage link. Also tag enterprise accounts in tracker for legal review.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping thread in 48 hours if tickets still open.

ana: Thanks. Keep updates here minimal so CS has a clean view.

[end of thread]
